contract: design-contract.md: operational trip workspace, progressively disclosed comparison, 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile, backend-authoritative safety and recommendation

accessibility.evidence: Playwright axe WCAG2 A/AA scans passed for initial desktop and final mobile results. Keyboard Tab moved from Origin to Destination; labels, pressed route buttons and native checkpoint selector exercised. Visible focus styles and reduced-motion mode inspected. Earlier eyebrow contrast failures corrected.

responsive.evidence: Inspected desktop-results.png, desktop-checkpoint.png and mobile-results.png. Desktop recommendation is visible beside a larger map; mobile stacks usable controls, cards and 470px map. Playwright measured body scrollWidth exactly 390 at a 390px viewport; map resizes/refits without remounting.

empty.evidence: desktop-initial.png and mobile-initial.png show labeled form and real basemap, with no fake route cards.

loading.evidence: desktop-loading.png shows disabled Analyze action, explicit forecast waiting message and cancel. Unit tests verify duplicate-submit lock and cancellation.

error.evidence: desktop-error.png shows sanitized structured provider error with retained inputs and retry; desktop-map-error.png covers real MapLibre style failure and recovery. Malformed geometry was rejected before map rendering.

partial.evidence: desktop-partial.png and mobile-partial.png use clearly documented synthetic fixtures for confirmed No Travel plus incomplete weather, no recommendation, unknown mileage and checkpoint details; no invented live hazards.

success.evidence: Real browser POST through Vite reached Django and returned 3 genuine truck alternatives. desktop-results.png shows provider geometry and backend recommendation; checkpoint circle click opened actual weather. Only one analysis request occurred while switching routes/checkpoints.

permission.reason: No login, geolocation, permission prompt or credential input exists in this scope.

renderedEvidence.observation: Real basemap and three real road routes; selected route and severity checkpoints are distinct. Recommendation and comparison remain in the first viewport.
Route 2 selection and compact forecast panel with actual arrival, units, completeness and risk explanations.
Stacked cards and map without horizontal overflow; native checkpoint selection and bounded scrollable weather panel remain usable.
Synthetic partial/no-travel fixture retains safety warnings and absence of a recommendation in the mobile layout.
